title: Middle Eastern-Style Broccoli Skewers
description: A gluten-free, flavorful recipe featuring marinated broccoli florets grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Cut the broccoli into florets and place in a large bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together the garlicky olive oil, middle eastern spice mix, and sprouting broccoli salt.
Pour the marinade over the broccoli and toss to coat.
Thread the marinated broccoli onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the broccoli is tender and slightly charred.
